verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms an official iOS app (App Store listing cited repeatedly, e.g. muse-docs-3/4/17/18) and mobile access is mentioned generally ('Muse app on mobile, Mac, or directly in WhatsApp'), but no Android/Google Play listing or Android-specific evidence appears anywhere in the pack. Missing for 10: confirmation of an Android app, evidence of feature parity between iOS/Android, and any independent hands-on review of the mobile apps' full feature set.
